fact_text: The analyst suggests splitting regular monthly investing into two halves: about half on a fixed schedule into a broad index fund, and half into a handful of stocks the investor knows well.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'He Fed My Entire YouTube Channel Into AI - Then Built His Investment Strategy' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A market index is argued to reduce single-company risk because a weak constituent is offset by the rest of the index, which is why it is used as the core holding.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'He Fed My Entire YouTube Channel Into AI - Then Built His Investment Strategy' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's rule is to keep holding a stock while its fundamentals stay intact, and to re-check those fundamentals against recent news before adding more money.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'He Fed My Entire YouTube Channel Into AI - Then Built His Investment Strategy' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Two sources of return are described for a stock: growth in company profits, and a low P/E multiple that re-rates upward; a company priced below its fair P/E gives a margin of safety.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'He Fed My Entire YouTube Channel Into AI - Then Built His Investment Strategy' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: At Pakistan's historically typical inflation of about 10% a year, prices roughly double in about seven years, which the analyst uses to set long-term nominal targets.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'He Fed My Entire YouTube Channel Into AI - Then Built His Investment Strategy' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Cement cannot be shipped far economically, so a maker's market is largely regional, and provincial policies differ from one region to another.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'He Fed My Entire YouTube Channel Into AI - Then Built His Investment Strategy' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mutual fund returns are reduced by front-end load, back-end load and management fees, so an investor's return can trail the fund's own top holdings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'He Fed My Entire YouTube Channel Into AI - Then Built His Investment Strategy' (YouTube transcript, undated)
